runtime.role: W35 only, original N80/1600-control evaluation case

optional.--schema: defaults to producer.schema_path from that FINAL

CLI.source_sha_meaning: Actual candidate checkpoint/model SHA bound by FINAL.source_cache.source_SHA, header.source_model_SHA and each target row.source_SHA; NOT the Python d841 source hash.
CLI.root_binding: resolved FINAL, input and schema must all be files inside explicit own case-root; producer.path and producer.schema_path must exactly resolve to those input files
CLI.data_io: one binary open, one forward stream/hash pass; no seek/reopen
CLI.metadata_io: FINAL once; exact schema bytes once; header constants decoded without row-field loss
CLI.output: full JSON on stdout and exclusive NEW JSON file; no overwrites or producer edits
CLI.return_0: artifact-bound retained original Boolean facts consumed; inspect unknown/drop fields before any population statement
CLI.return_2: input/binding/format/hash/producer-integrity failure; structural n/N may be observed but rates are null when integrity is unverified
CLI.admission_or_actual_parent_wait: not asserted by consumer; parent must use its already-reviewed actual closure/wait gate

stream_consume.signature: stream_consume(stream, *, schema, expected_role, expected_source_sha, producer=None, case_metadata=None, expected_group_id=None, schema_raw=None, data_basename=None)
stream_consume.stream: caller-owned binary file-like object implementing readline; function neither opens paths nor closes caller stream
stream_consume.schema_raw: the very same original header bytes, required for byte attestation; do not serialize a substitute
stream_consume.producer: exact rows.finish() producer receipt, not recomputed/fabricated expectations
stream_consume.case_metadata: newly closed original worker FINAL, not an inferred role hint
stream_consume.missing_binding: target records quarantined as unknown; no inferred role/source/UID
stream_consume.missing_bytes_attestation: observed n/N retained but rate null; explicit metadata evidence gap

grading.row_encoding: [schema_id,[values in schema positional_fields order]] plus exact schema.constants
grading.group: standing must be an actual bool: True=>standing, False=>moving, missing/nonbool=>unknown_standing; never derive from vx
grading.N: retained, source/UID/integrity-valid target rows with original natural_complete_nonterminal_interval is True
grading.n: those N rows with original complete_interval_bounds_fact is True
grading.false: those N rows with original complete_interval_bounds_fact is False
grading.partial: valid target rows with original natural_complete_nonterminal_interval is False; excluded from conditional N, not relabeled as passes
grading.unknown: missing or malformed relevant UID/Boolean/source/counter evidence, contradictions or duplicates; never imputed
grading.duplicate_policy: all same-identity copies are unknown; prior n/N/partial contribution is revoked, not first-pass preferred
integrity_only_checks_not_new_skill_thre: complete implies start_observed and no ter/tru
grading.rate: n/N for artifact-attested retained valid rows, null when N=0 or integrity attestation fails
grading.wilson95: descriptive 95% Wilson interval for that retained n/N, not an acceptance threshold; N=0 null
grading.all_original_complete_population_rate: null if any unknown, drops, metadata gap, format error or integrity failure; also null for N=0
grading.drops: global original producer dropped_rows/attempted_rows retained; no guessed moving/standing allocation
grading.raw_preservation: input untouched; full data SHA plus ordered original UID/source/flags/end-reason provenance SHA, per-group partial/ter/tru/end reasons, original reason flags, bounded unknown line/UID examples
